name: GitHub Primer
licence: MIT (@primer/primitives 11.10.0 and @primer/react 38.40.1, copyright GitHub Inc.). Octicons/Mona Sans/GitHub marks are separate assets with their own terms (not verified here).
bestFor: dense product UI for developer, ops and admin tools
list/table/detail-heavy SaaS where a page is a stack of bordered rows and panes
products that must ship colour-blind, high-contrast and dark themes as first-class modes
teams that want machine-checkable token rules (the package ships an RFC 2119 guide for LLMs)
avoidFor: brand-led marketing or campaign pages (GitHub has a separate system, Primer Brand, for that)
expressive, high-emotion or editorial layouts; the system deliberately has almost no decorative vocabulary
touch-first consumer apps unless the coarse-pointer tokens are wired (fine-pointer default target is only 16px)

families: sans (body, title-small): 'Mona Sans VF', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans Backtick Fix', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji'
sansDisplay (display, title-large/medium, subtitle): same stack as sans (semantic alias only)
mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
typography.notes: Base size scale (rem): 12, 14, 16, 20, 32, 40 px = xs, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl. Weights: 300, 400, 500, 600 only (guide says never use arbitrary weights such as 700). Line-heights are unitless: tight 1.25, snug 1.375, normal 1.5, relaxed 1.625, loose 1.75. Every text style is shipped as a CSS `font` shorthand token (weight size/line-height family) so size, leading and weight cannot drift apart. Guide: downgrade one size level on mobile (title-large to title-medium); keep line length around 80 characters or fewer; left-aligned ragged right; do not use colour as the primary emphasis device. Docs claim line-heights align to a 4px grid but the computed values (21, 19.5, 32.5px) do not; treat the claim as aspirational. No letter-spacing tokens exist (trackingEm 'none-defined').

color.darkMode: Not an inversion layer but 14 first-class theme files generated from the same token source: light, light-high-contrast, light-colorblind, light-colorblind-high-contrast, light-tritanopia, light-tritanopia-high-contrast, dark, dark-dimmed, dark-high-contrast, dark-colorblind, dark-colorblind-high-contrast, dark-tritanopia, dark-tritanopia-high-contrast, dark-dimmed-high-contrast. The base neutral scale 0-13 is deliberately inverted between light and dark so the same functional token (e.g. bgColor-muted = step 1 light / step 2 dark) works unchanged. Shadows change character: dark resting shadows are #010409 at 60% alpha and floating shadows gain a 1px #3d444d ring because shadows are hard to see on dark. Colour-blind themes remap semantic meaning (light-colorblind: success becomes blue #0969da, danger becomes orange #bc4c00).
color.contrastNotes: Docs: neutral steps 0-5 are backgrounds, 7-8 borders/dividers, 9-10 text/icons; step 9 is the minimum for text on steps 0-4, step 10 on steps 5-6; step 8 is the minimum contrast for interactive-control borders against bgColor-muted. All text/border contrast is calculated against bgColor-muted. High contrast themes target 7:1 for most text and interactive elements (light-HC uses steps 2-7 for backgrounds, 10 for borders, 11-13 for text; borderColor-default becomes #454c54 = 8.7:1 on white). Pairing rules: emphasis bg MUST pair with fgColor-onEmphasis; muted bg takes the semantic fg; never fgColor-muted on bgColor-muted. [computed] fg-default on bg-default light 15.8:1; fg-muted on bg-default 6.11:1; neutral-8 (#818b98) border on bg-muted 3.24:1; white on bgColor-success-emphasis 4.52:1 (barely passes); fg-disabled 3.45:1 (disabled is exempt); dark fg-muted on dark bg 6.5:1. Disabled is expressed with dedicated disabled tokens, never opacity.

layout.contentPaddingPx: 16 up to large, 24 at xlarge and xxlarge; pane padding 16 always
layout.maxWidthPx: 1280 for full pages (content incl. 24px padding = 1232 visible); 320 for interstitial pages

radius.rule: Four steps only: small 3px (compact variants), medium 6px (the default alias borderRadius.default; controls, cards, overlays), large 12px (softer large surfaces), full (pills). Overlay radius is 6px. No nesting rule is published.

depth.borders: 1px (borderWidth.thin, the default alias), 2px thick, 4px thicker. Thick/thicker are also provided as inset box-shadow rings (boxShadow.thick etc.) to emphasise without layout shift. Default separation is a 1px #d1d9e0 border (borderColor-default); borderColor-muted is the same colour at 70% alpha; borderColor-translucent (#1f232826) is used on filled buttons. GitHub is border-led: depth is mostly hairlines plus a pair of resting shadows, floating shadows only for overlays.
depth.blur: No backdrop-filter/blur tokens. Overlay backdrop is a flat tinted scrim (#c8d1da66 light). Shadow blur radii 1-6px resting, 12-112px floating.

motion.notes: Semantic durations: micro 100 (hover, focus ring, colour shifts), short 200 (expand/collapse, toggles), medium 300 (modals, dropdowns entering), long 500 (rare). Composite transition tokens: hover = 100ms ease; enter = 300ms easeOut; exit = 200ms easeIn (exits are faster than entrances); stateChange = 200ms easeInOut. Rules (RFC 2119 in the shipped guide): MUST use motion.transition.* for interactive state changes; UI animation <= 300ms; NEVER exceed 500ms; MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion with an instant alternative; NEVER decorative; NEVER indefinite loops without user control; NEVER convey information by motion alone. Loading thresholds: <1s show nothing, 1-3s indeterminate, 3-10s determinate, >10s determinate plus background task.

modes: pointer: fine vs coarse (min target 16px fine, 44px coarse)

components.stateMatrixCompleteness: High and machine-enforced. Count 62 is the primer.style/product/components listing; @primer/react ships 80 generated entries including deprecated/legacy (status counts in components.json: alpha 56, deprecated 11, draft 7, beta 6; per-component a11yReviewed dates). Button: variants default (secondary), primary, invisible, danger, plus `inactive` (looks disabled, stays interactive and contrast-compliant) and `disabled`; sizes small/medium/large; leading/trailing visual, trailing action, counter, block, alignContent. Colour tokens exist per variant x property x state (button-primary-bgColor-rest/hover/active/disabled; control-*; button-outline, button-danger, button-invisible, button-inactive). The shipped DESIGN_TOKENS_GUIDE mandates all five interactive states on every element: rest, :hover, :focus-visible (never :focus alone), :active, :disabled/aria-disabled, and forbids opacity for disabled.

tokenArchitecture: Three tiers. (1) base: raw scales (base/size 2-128px, base/text size/lineHeight/weight, base/duration, base/easing, base/zIndex, base/color neutral 0-13 + hue scales) that 'respect no colour mode and are never used directly'. (2) functional: the default choice, themed per mode, categories bgColor / fgColor / borderColor / shadow / control / focus / overlay / text / space / size / borderRadius / motion / zIndex / fontStack. (3) component/pattern: button-*, control-*, avatar, label, treeView, diffBlob, codeMirror, contribution, etc. (use sparingly, only where functional tokens cannot express it). Naming: camelCase category + hyphenated modifiers, `--{category}-{role}-{property?}-{emphasis|size|state}`: bgColor-danger-emphasis, fgColor-onEmphasis, control-medium-paddingInline-normal, text-body-shorthand-medium, motion-transition-hover. Semantic role words: accent, success, attention, danger, severe, done, sponsors, neutral, open, closed, draft, upsell; two emphasis levels `muted` and `emphasis`; default/inset/disabled/inverse/transparent surfaces. Source is DTCG-style json5 compiled by Style Dictionary into CSS, Figma variables and fallbacks (959 unique custom properties in light.css; 1120 across functional css). Deprecated/removed tokens are tracked in deprecated.json and removed.json. Ships DESIGN_TOKENS_GUIDE.md and DESIGN_TOKENS_SPEC.md written for LLMs with an explicit 'Hallucination Guard': an invented token name must be suffixed with /* check-token */.
distinctiveness: GitHub-ness is carried by (1) a cool blue-grey neutral ramp (#f6f8fa / #d1d9e0 / #1f2328) rather than pure grey, (2) green primary buttons (success colour as the primary action, with a translucent border and 1px inset highlight), (3) hairline-bordered panes with small 6px radii, (4) 14px default body with 32px controls, (5) semantic state labels with a distinctive hue per object state (open green, closed red, done purple, sponsors pink, draft grey). Without those it would look like any bordered SaaS admin; the system is intentionally low-ornament.
weaknesses: Almost no expressive vocabulary: no editorial type, no brand motion, no illustration rules beyond Blankslate; marketing needs Primer Brand
Fine-pointer minimum target is 16px; below WCAG 2.2 AA 24px target size unless the control itself is larger (controls start at 24px high)
Docs pages for primitives list token values with almost no usage guidance; the real rules live in the package guide and Accessibility section
Component-status taxonomy is noisy (56 of 80 React entries alpha) which makes 'what is safe to use' unclear
Docs claim line heights sit on a 4px grid but several do not (21, 19.5, 32.5px)
Documentation said nine themes while the package ships 14; docs lag code
takeaways: Ship the system as a token spec an LLM can obey: RFC 2119 keywords, a pairing matrix (bg token -> required fg token), and a hallucination guard for unknown token names
Pair rules are the cheapest correctness check: emphasis bg + onEmphasis fg; muted bg + semantic fg; never muted-on-muted
Bundle size + line-height + weight into one shorthand token per text role so they cannot drift; give each role a documented job
Define the five interactive states (rest, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled) as a mandatory checklist and ban opacity for disabled
Make density a first-class axis (condensed/normal/spacious) plus pointer coarse/fine, not a global scale change
Express every theme (HC, colour-blind, dimmed) as generated output of one token source; semantic roles remap, components do not fork
Tie elevation to z-index and shadow level (resting -> default/sticky, floating small/medium -> dropdown/overlay, large/xlarge -> modal/popover) and add a 1px ring to floating shadows in dark mode
Pair motion tokens with exit-faster-than-enter and a hard 300ms/500ms cap
